# Coloring Dictionary

> A dictionary you can color.

**Coloring Dictionary** pairs a readable explanation and colored example with a facing illustration to color. Motto: Color • Learn • Grow.

## Primary URLs

- Home: https://coloringdictionary.com/
- Flower Meanings collection: https://coloringdictionary.com/#collection
- FAQ: https://coloringdictionary.com/#faq
- Launch updates / signup: https://coloringdictionary.com/#updates
- Brand facts (JSON): https://coloringdictionary.com/brand.json
- Book facts (JSON): https://coloringdictionary.com/book.json
- Discovery: https://coloringdictionary.com/discovery.json
- Structured data: https://coloringdictionary.com/json.ld
- Sitemap: https://coloringdictionary.com/sitemap.xml

## First collection

**Flower Meanings · Volume One** — in production (not for sale yet).

Sample entries:

1. [Coreopsis](https://coloringdictionary.com/flowers/coreopsis/) — Always cheerful. “You bring sunshine to my day.”
2. [Pink Carnation](https://coloringdictionary.com/flowers/pink-carnation/) — I’ll never forget you. “I will always remember you.”
3. [White Clover](https://coloringdictionary.com/flowers/white-clover/) — Think of me. “Keep me in your thoughts.” Scientific name: *Trifolium repens*.

## How the book works

1. Meet the subject — name, meaning, memorable facts on the left-hand guide page.
2. Find your colors — look at the colored examples.
3. Make it yours — color the facing illustration. Natural colors are a guide; your colors are your choice.

## FAQ

- **What is Coloring Dictionary?** A publishing brand that pairs readable explanations and colored examples with facing illustrations to color. Flower Meanings is its first collection.
- **How does the two-page format work?** English edition: guide on the left, coloring illustration on the right.
- **Must I use natural flower colors?** No.
- **Can I buy Volume One?** Not yet — in production. Site images are draft/concept.
- **Are flower meanings universal?** No — they vary across cultures and dictionaries; this collection shares selected, sourced associations.
- **Other subjects/languages?** Planned expansions, not available products yet.

## GEO / AEO / VCAP

- Brand palette: Deep teal `#00505A`, Night teal `#082F35`, Warm cream `#FFF5DB`, Coloring gold `#FFC629`, Reading ink `#202A2D`
- Machine surfaces: `/llms.txt`, `/brand.json`, `/book.json`, `/mcp.json`, `/openapi.json`, `/json.ld`, `/discovery.json`
- Activity tracking (AIWEB HITS): `POST /api/vcap/hit` → Big Search `POST https://bigsearchai.com/api/v1/registry/access` with `sourceRegistry=coloringdictionary`, `slug=coloring-dictionary`
